"""Offline geometric evaluation counterexamples; does not modify repository files."""
import sys,json,math,platform
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
import shapely
from shapely.geometry import Polygon
from shapely.ops import unary_union
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/slian/Desktop/3D/Worldedge/fastfill-v4')
from fastfill.v2.ops import layout_quality as Q
from fastfill.v2.ops import v3_metrics as V3
from fastfill.v2.schema import validate_layout
from fastfill.v2.validation import validate_scene
from fastfill.v2.evaluate import reference_metrics

SCHEMA='fastfill.v2'
def mkrow(room,objects,target):
 n=len(objects)
 return {'schema_version':SCHEMA,'condition':{'schema_version':SCHEMA,'room':{'frame':'right_handed_z_up','floor_z_m':0.,'height_m':3.,'floor_known':True,'boundary_known':True,**room},'objects':objects,'constraints':[]},'target':{'schema_version':SCHEMA,'objects':target},'validity':{'position':[[True]*3]*n,'size':[[True]*3]*n,'yaw':[True]*n,'yaw_symmetry_order':[2]*n,'size_axis_swap_allowed':[False]*n,'exchangeable_group':[None]*n},'provenance':{'source':'synthetic','group':'example','scene_id':'example','split':'test'}}
def obj(i,size,pos,yaw=0.):return {'id':i,'target_size_local_m':size,'bottom_center_m':pos,'yaw_rad':yaw}
def request(i,cat):return {'id':i,'category':cat,'description':cat,'support_parent':'floor'}

# 20 cm passage joins all point-agent free space, but a 60 cm-wide agent cannot pass.
room={'floor_polygon_xy_m':[[0.,0.],[8.,0.],[8.,4.],[0.,4.]],'openings':[{'id':'entrance','type':'door','wall_index':3,'position_on_wall':.5,'width_m':.9,'height_m':2.1}], 'fixed_objects':[{'id':'divider_low','size_local_m':[.3,1.9,2.],'bottom_center_m':[2.,.95,0.],'yaw_rad':0.},{'id':'divider_high','size_local_m':[.3,1.9,2.],'bottom_center_m':[2.,3.05,0.],'yaw_rad':0.}]}
row=mkrow(room,[request('chair','chair')],[obj('chair',[.5,.5,.8],[6.,2.,0.])]);bs=Q.boxes(row,row['target'])
floor=Polygon(room['floor_polygon_xy_m']);x0,y0,x1,y1=floor.bounds
xs=np.arange(x0+Q.CELL_M/2,x1,Q.CELL_M);ys=np.arange(y0+Q.CELL_M/2,y1,Q.CELL_M);gx,gy=np.meshgrid(xs,ys)
free=shapely.contains_xy(floor,gx,gy);blocked=unary_union([b['poly'] for b in bs if Q.obstacle(b)]+Q.fixed_obstacles(row));free&=~shapely.contains_xy(blocked,gx,gy)
clearance=ndimage.distance_transform_edt(np.pad(free,1,constant_values=False))[1:-1,1:-1]*Q.CELL_M
walkable=free&(clearance>=.3);labels,n=ndimage.label(walkable)
seed=(int(np.argmin(abs(ys-2.))),int(np.argmin(abs(xs-.4))))
door_component=labels[seed];reachable=(labels==door_component)&(door_component>0)
chair_approach=(int(np.argmin(abs(ys-2.))),int(np.argmin(abs(xs-5.5))))
nav_result={'passage_width_m':.2,'agent_diameter_m':.6,'NAV_largest_point_free_component':Q.nav(row,bs),'ACC_local_strip':Q.acc(row,bs),'door_seed_xy_m':[.4,2.],'agent_clearance_components':int(n),'door_reachable_walkable_fraction':float(reachable.sum()/walkable.sum()),'chair_approach_reachable':bool(reachable[chair_approach])}

# Two globally rotated valid layouts for an unconstrained square shell.
room2={'floor_polygon_xy_m':[[0.,0.],[6.,0.],[6.,6.],[0.,6.]]}
a=[obj('sofa',[1.,1.,1.],[1.5,2.,0.]),obj('table',[1.,1.,.6],[4.5,2.,0.])]
b=[obj('sofa',[1.,1.,1.],[4.5,4.,0.],-math.pi),obj('table',[1.,1.,.6],[1.5,4.,0.],-math.pi)]
r=mkrow(room2,[request('sofa','sofa'),request('table','table')],a);layoutb={'schema_version':SCHEMA,'objects':b}
qa=Q.boxes(r,r['target']);qb=Q.boxes(r,layoutb)
multi={'A_bbox_valid':validate_scene(r['condition'],a)['ok'],'B_bbox_valid':validate_scene(r['condition'],b)['ok'],'NAV_A':Q.nav(r,qa),'NAV_B':Q.nav(r,qb),'ACC_A':Q.acc(r,qa),'ACC_B':Q.acc(r,qb),'SG_B_against_A':Q.sg(r,qb),'GT_bottom_center_error_B_m':reference_metrics(layoutb,r)['bottom_center_error_m'],'interpretation':'Empty symmetric shell with no requested spatial relations: both preserve the sofa-table functional orientation after global 180-degree rotation, yet world-frame SG recall is 0.'}

# Ancillary scorers skip failed rooms and accept duplicate IDs collapsed by dict.
quality_with_failure=Q.score_method([r,r],[r['target'],None],[])
quality_all_valid=Q.score_method([r,r],[r['target'],r['target']],[])
duplicate={'schema_version':SCHEMA,'objects':[a[0],a[0],a[1]]}
try:validate_layout(duplicate,r['condition']);strict='accepted'
except ValueError as e:strict=str(e)
ir,decl,z0=V3.ir_room(r);v3got=V3.placements(ir,decl,duplicate,z0)
inventory={'requested_ids':['sofa','table'],'returned_ids':['sofa','sofa','table'],'strict_schema':strict,'v3_placements_accepts_duplicate':v3got is not None,'quality_with_one_failed_request':quality_with_failure,'quality_all_requests_successful':quality_all_valid,'interpretation':'The helper metrics are conditional on supplied layouts; failure/inventory gates must be enforced before publishing them as overall task success.'}
report={'environment':{'python':platform.python_version(),'numpy':np.__version__,'shapely':shapely.__version__},'NAV_and_ACC_counterexample':nav_result,'multi_solution_counterexample':multi,'inventory_and_failure_counterexample':inventory}
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2));Path('/tmp/fastfill-current-eval-counterexamples.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
